title: The Nerdy Nummies Cookbook: Sweet Treats for the Geek in All of Us
reason: Okay so this one basically wrote itself — I'm literally in software/AI AND culinary arts, so a cookbook that fuses geek culture with baking is like... someone scraped my brain and turned it into a book. Apple Pi Pie? Chocolate Chip Smart Cookies? Periodic Table of Cupcakes?? The intersection of STEM aesthetics and food craft is exactly where I live. Plus the visual photo-per-recipe format is perfect for my visual learning style. Value-driven purchase: one book that covers two of my core domains. Sold.
